if (depth > 64 || estimate > REPORT_CAP) throw new Error('terminal report bound reached');
    if (typeof value === 'string') estimate += Buffer.byteLength(value) * 6 + 2;
evidence.reason: The bound check at line 951 runs only when `visit` is entered. Line 952 can raise `estimate` above `REPORT_CAP` for a string, and no later check runs before `JSON.stringify` at line 966 serializes the entire report. Thus a large final string can force the unbounded JSON allocation the walk is intended to prevent; the post-serialization `bytes.length` check at line 967 rejects only after allocation.
